body: The input validation is inconsistent in `window.py`. I was proposing to reuse ``_prep_window` to unify behaviour. Could somebody familiar with the code offer guidance (instead of spot fixes)? Thanks
@gliptak these DO have different validations, as `Window` can accept an integer or an integer array, while `Rolling` can only accept an integer. This does not require a big change.
I closed https://github.com/pydata/pandas/issues/12714, https://github.com/pydata/pandas/pull/12718 is closer to the approach described.
